candidate_population: all development-valid candidates admitted before each replayed generation

policies.description: Use the frozen policy_effect_trace parent pools exactly as recorded.

Prefer candidates within 0.5% of the contemporaneous development incumbent, ordered by development quality, novelty, information gain, and candidate id; retain valid candidates in the archive even when they are not preferred parents.

Use the incumbent guardrail for the quality slot. After three consecutive generations without an incumbent refresh, require the second slot to come from a different root lineage; emit ESCAPE_REQUIRED when the frozen candidate pool contains no such lineage.

metrics: mean parent quality relative to contemporaneous incumbent
parent HHI and effective parent count
escape-required slots and first trigger generation
best candidate reachable in the frozen pool
causal_boundary: Replay identifies counterfactual pressure over the frozen candidate pool. It does not identify candidates that would have been generated under a changed parent policy and therefore cannot estimate counterfactual final search quality.
